name: Bundle of Hides
summary: Across the Barrens, a Bundle of Hides travels toward Thunder Bluff with the Horde’s wind riders. The cured skins are a straightforward courier shipment for the leatherworkers, and their delivery introduces travelers to the wind rider network.

sections.title: Frontier Trade
sections.body: Hunters skin the beasts of the Barrens for cured hides. The plains hold vast herds of kodo, prowling lions, and roving raptors. These skins supply the leatherworkers of Thunder Bluff, who turn them into gear, pouches, armor, and bindings for the Horde.

sections.title: Skyward Freight
sections.body: Couriers carry the bundle from the Crossroads to Thunder Bluff on Devrak’s trained wyverns. Overland travel through the Barrens and into Mulgore is slow and dangerous, with roaming quilboar and centaur raiders. Handing the hides to a wind rider courier shows how swiftly air travel can cross Kalimdor’s fractured terrain.

faq.q: What is the Bundle of Hides used for?
faq.answer: The Bundle of Hides carries skins gathered from animals across the Barrens to Ahanu, a leatherworker in Thunder Bluff. He makes leather goods and armaments for the tauren and their Horde allies.

faq.q: Who receives the shipment in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Ahanu receives the parcel at Hewa’s Armory, directly at the base of Thunder Bluff’s wind rider roost.

faq.q: Why send this bundle via a wind rider?
faq.answer: The Crossroads-to-Thunder Bluff journey on foot takes days and risks ambush by centaur or quilboar. Devrak, the Crossroads flight master, carries the goods atop a wind rider so they arrive swiftly and safely.

faq.q: Who prepared the bundle in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Jahan Hawkwing prepared the bundle from animals of the Barrens. He is a leather and mail armor merchant at the Crossroads and a colleague of Ahanu.

angles.text: Simple shipments like pelts cross the sky on wyvern flight paths, binding isolated Horde outposts directly to sovereign capital cities.
As a tauren, you rely on natural materials and reverent hunting, turning hides from the neighboring savanna into armor and crafts sold in Mulgore’s stalls.
